data.name: Thatcher
data.short_meaning: From the Old English word 'thic' meaning 'thatch' or 'roof', and 'er' meaning 'child'.
data.long_meaning: Thatcher is an Old English name derived from the words 'thic' meaning 'thatch' or 'roof', and 'er' meaning 'child'. It refers to someone who builds or repairs thatched roofs. In the Middle Ages, thatchers were highly respected members of their communities for their craftsmanship and skill in protecting homes from the elements.
